edges: Obama's political standing and legacy are intertwined with reaching an accord with Iran.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The deal will be accepted if Iran ends its nuclear program.
Iran came to the negotiating table despite the absence of harsh international sanctions and a stable oil market.
Iran will be allowed to keep one-third of its more than 6,000 centrifuges.
